summary: Require regression tests for every bug fix in both GitHub and Gitea Actions. API impact: none; contributor policy only.

guide.reason: Contributor verification policy only; operator workflows are unchanged.

api.reason: No client-facing API, Controller operation, Core command, or observed-state/result flow changes.

verification.method: Review the rule against both existing workflow locations; run python3 scripts/check_docs.py --all and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_check_docs.py'. Hosted runs and commit-range checks are not part of this uncommitted policy-only change.
